propositions: rebar search does not match tickets by their canonical ticket_id, human alias, or bound Jira key; only full-text over title, description, tags, and comment bodies

the search haystack omits identifier fields (ticket_id, alias, jira_key) that users expect to be searchable, creating a discoverability footgun where 'search REB-1654' returns empty despite 'show REB-1654' resolving correctly
_haystack must be extended to include lowercased ticket_id, alias, and jira_key; jira_key enrichment must happen in the caller search_state without making the reducer impure
identifier matching must be case-folded on both sides so uppercase and lowercase variants (REB-1654 vs reb-1654) match identically
existing full-text search behavior and predicate grammar must remain unchanged; identifier matching should use the same substring haystack path, not a separate exact-match predicate
